properties.__carriedNote: The boundary source labels this ground "Chimú" in 1492, a state that had ended by then. The shape is the source's; the name is corrected to the polity that held it.

properties.NAME: Bahmani Sultanate
properties.__carriedNote: The boundary source labels this ground "Golkonda" in 1492, a state that did not exist yet. The shape is the source's; the name is corrected to the polity that held it.

properties.NAME: Swahili city-states
properties.__claimNote: The Swahili coast article names Sofala, Kilwa, Mombasa, Gede and Pate among its towns. The source draws none of them in any year. The claim is the coastal strip and islands, with the inland limit computed one degree west of the real coastline rather than drawn by hand, because these were ports with a shallow hinterland. Kilwa Kisiwani itself is too small an island to appear in Natural Earth land, so the island seat is not drawn even here.

properties.NAME: Delhi Sultanate
properties.__claimNote: Bahlul Lodi rebuilt the sultanate from Sirhind, took Jaunpur in 1479, and Sikandar Lodi pushed into Bihar. The Lodis held the Punjab and the plain again until Panipat.

properties.NAME: Vijayanagara Empire
properties.__claimNote: The peninsula south of the Krishna and Tungabhadra. The doab between the two rivers was contested with the Bahmanis throughout and is not separately drawn.

properties.NAME: Bengal Sultanate
properties.__claimNote: Independent of Delhi from Ilyas Shah's unification until the Mughal conquest.

properties.NAME: Gujarat Sultanate
properties.__claimNote: Zafar Khan governed Gujarat from 1391; Muzaffar Shah I declared independence from the Tughlaqs in 1394 and the line took the sultan's title in 1407. The claim starts at the declaration.

properties.NAME: Malwa Sultanate
properties.__claimNote: Independent of Delhi from 1392 until Akbar annexed it.

properties.NAME: Gajapati Kingdom
properties.__claimNote: The Gajapatis held the Kalinga coast from the Mahanadi toward the Godavari.

properties.NAME: Kingdom of Mewar
properties.__claimNote: The Sisodia state in the southern Aravallis — Chittor until 1568, then Udaipur. Marwar, Amber, Bikaner and Jaisalmer were separate Rajput states and are left to the boundary source rather than folded into this one.

properties.NAME: Samma dynasty of Sindh
properties.__claimNote: The Sammas ruled the lower Indus from Thatta, independent of Delhi.

properties.NAME: Kingdom of Ladakh
properties.__claimNote: The Namgyal dynasty article has the kingdom lasting 1460 to 1842 with conflicts against the NEIGHBOURING Mughal Empire -- neighbouring, so Leh was never inside it. The source draws Mughal Empire over Leh at 1715, Lahore at 1783, Afghanistan at 1800 and the Maratha Confederacy at 1815. None of those held Ladakh. It fell to the Dogras in 1842.

properties.NAME: Majapahit
properties.__claimNote: Majapahit from Trowulan in eastern Java. The source draws Kediri over Trowulan at 1300 and 1400 -- Kediri was conquered in 1293 -- and Malaysian Islamic states at 1492 and 1500. The wider thalassocracy across the archipelago is disputed in the scholarship and is not drawn.

properties.NAME: Kalmar Union
properties.__carriedNote: The boundary source does not draw Kalmar Union in this year. Shape held in both 1400 and 1500.
